policy: Stage order and prerequisites enforced by suite.py lifecycle/checkpoint/advance. A stage is passed only through its recorded human decision or a passed, current gate report. Records establish provenance, not cryptographic proof.

stages.purpose: Classify the request, read repository instructions and Git state, open the task record.
Owner approves the product brief and its open decisions.
Owner approves REQ IDs, acceptance cases and exclusions.
Owner approves journeys, the visual reference and screen-inventory.json; their hashes become the conformance baseline.
ADRs, module map and interface contracts.
Implementation slices by the engineering owners; accepted handoffs recorded.
Compile, static analysis, executed tests and independent code review on the current source.
Independent element-by-element conformance with the approved design from current screenshots. Mandatory whenever the design stage approved an inventory.
Owner reviews the delivered app, screenshots next to the reference, test and review results, and accepts or requests changes.
Signed release artifact, required tests, security review and policy checks.
Listing, store assets from the accepted build, Data safety, content rating and privacy policy.
Owner authorizes the exact bundle, package, version, track and rollout; the approved submission runs once.
Monitoring, incident response and maintenance after release.
